annotations.title: Check whether a UK shop has a sale on

description: Checks whether a UK shop has a sale on today and when it ends. Returns each sale the shop is running now with its start and end dates and a link, its sales from the latest December and January, and the dates of its sales in each earlier season. From January Sales' listings of UK shops' sales all year round (Black Friday, Boxing Day, January and the seasons between).
name: check_shop_sales

ends.description: The day it ends or ended, UK time, when it has an end date

linkUrl.description: January Sales' link to the sale at the shop, while it runs

started.description: The day the sale started, UK time (yyyy-mm-dd)

seasons.description: The shop's sales by season, newest first: each season's first start and last end

ends.description: The day its last sale of the season ends or ended, UK time

season.description: The season and year, e.g. 'Black Friday 2026', 'January 2026'

started.description: The day the shop's first sale of the season started, UK time (yyyy-mm-dd)

suggestions.description: Shop names to try when nothing matched

winter.description: Sales from the latest December to January season
